criteria.name: Manuscript and versions
criteria.evidence: paper.pdf; 15 TeX/Bib source files; 24 archive version candidates

criteria.name: AI / human contribution
criteria.evidence: 3 role/task descriptions; the conversations record user/assistant/tool roles
criteria.gap: Role labels cannot verify real-person identity, human decisions, edit ownership, or author contribution statements.

criteria.name: Generation trace
criteria.evidence: 217 conversation JSONL files; 980 worker logs/results; text traces were packaged
criteria.gap: Obvious credentials were redacted and binary payloads such as images were omitted; consult the source archive for the complete original.

criteria.name: Reproduction code
criteria.gap: Reproduction is needed to verify that the environment remains installable and that the code matches the manuscript version.

criteria.name: Experiments and environment
criteria.evidence: 68 data/result files; datasets, configurations, and dependency manifests were collected
criteria.gap: Data permissions, hardware budget, completeness of failed runs, and cross-environment reproduction require item-by-item verification.

criteria.name: Validation evidence
criteria.evidence: 28 internal review reports; 15 audit/validation files; source identity not verified
criteria.gap: These files do not establish that human verification, independent reproduction, or public external review has been completed.
